summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BreatheEasy panic attack & anxiety support app MVP. All core functionality working including emergency flow, courses, tools, profile, and subscription system.
passed_tests: Backend API health checks (GET /api/, GET /api/health)
User authentication (register, login, get current user)
Courses API (get courses, course details, lessons)
Subscription plans API (get plans)
User settings API (get/update settings)
Panic sessions API (create/get sessions)
Error handling (401, 404 responses)
Home page loading with panic button and daily tip
Bottom navigation (5 tabs: Home, Help Now, Courses, Tools, Profile)
Help Now page with calming message and start button
Complete emergency flow (Safety → Breathing → Grounding → Reassurance → Recovery)
Breathing exercise with animated circle and pause/resume
Courses page with 3 course cards and navigation
Course detail page with modules and lessons
Tools page with breathing presets and 5 tool cards
Profile page with settings toggles (vibration, sound, voice)
Login page with email/password and Google OAuth
Register page with name, email, password fields
Subscription page with monthly ($9.99) and yearly ($79.99) plans
Mobile responsiveness
Emergency controls (sound/vibration toggles)
Settings persistence and updates
